# GoogleReviewAI

> GEO platform that helps local businesses rank inside ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, with AI review responses and automated local SEO.

GoogleReviewAI tracks how your business appears in answers generated by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude. It auto-publishes Q&A and SEO content on your Google Business Profile, and replies to Google reviews on-brand with AI.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of GoogleReviewAI – GEO ranking, AI reviews, local SEO.
- [Local AEO guide](/local-aeo): How to optimize for AI answer engines.
- [GMB autoposting guide](/gmb-autoposting): Automate Google Business Profile posts.
- [AI reviews for restaurants](/avis-ai-restaurant): AI review responses for restaurants.
- [AI reviews for hotels](/avis-ai-hotel): AI review responses for hotels.
- [AI reviews guide](/avis-ai-guide): Best practices for AI-powered review management.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on GEO, local SEO and Google reviews.
- [NFC shop](/shop): NFC plaques and cards to collect reviews.
- [Privacy policy](/privacy-policy): How GoogleReviewAI handles data.
